policy.ticker_visibility: show BPI and Global BPI always; show exchange only when latest.json has a valid current BTC/USD-normalized quote
policy.bitavg_inclusion: enabled exchange + BTC/XBT base + recognized fiat quote + positive USD-normalized price + usable BTC volume
policy.candidate_activation: do not set enabled=true until collector/API adapter passes runtime validation
policy.p2p_inclusion: P2P/non-custodial venues may contribute only when the collector can derive a valid BTC/fiat execution/reference price and a comparable executed BTC-volume metric. Advertised offers, order count, or depth alone must not be substituted for 24h BTC volume.
policy.ticker_visibility_p2p: A P2P venue appears in the ticker only when latest.json exposes a current positive price_usd for that venue; catalog presence alone is insufficient.
